name: Burg Berneck
kurzbeschreibung: The **13th-century** ruins of the **Höhenburg Berneck**, perched high above the **Kaunertal**, offer sweeping views across the valley.
beschreibung: Burg Berneck – Burg Berneck in Kauns uniquely blends history, art, and Tyrolean tradition. This 13th-century hilltop fortress ruin, perched high above the Kaunertal, offers sweeping valley views. Visitors explore valuable art treasures, historic rooms, and carefully curated exhibitions during a guided tour. Expert-led tours reveal fascinating insights into the castle’s history and its inhabitants. Regular special exhibitions and cultural events enhance the experience. Nestled picturesquely in the Imst region, the castle is surrounded by landscapes worth traveling for in themselves. The perfect mix of cultural enjoyment and nature makes a visit truly special. The combination of stunning scenery and warm hospitality ensures an unforgettable experience.
